assertions.assertion: Sets options.BackchannelHttpHandler to a SocketsHttpHandler with SslOptions.ClientCertificates (SslClientAuthenticationOptions) containing the client certificate
assertions.rationale: Uses HttpClientHandler with ClientCertificates, not SocketsHttpHandler with SslOptions.

assertions.assertion: Notes that no ClientSecret is required because the client certificate authenticates the client on back-channel calls
assertions.rationale: States no client secret is sent with tls_client_auth.

assertions.assertion: Implements a custom IConfigurationManager<OpenIdConnectConfiguration> that rewrites endpoints to the mtls_endpoint_aliases values from discovery
assertions.rationale: Only sets ConfigurationManager = null in prose-comment fashion; no IConfigurationManager implementation.

assertions.assertion: Rewrites TokenEndpoint, IntrospectionEndpoint, and DeviceAuthorizationEndpoint to their mTLS aliases
assertions.rationale: No code or statement rewriting Introspection/DeviceAuthorization endpoints; only token endpoint mentioned.

assertions.assertion: Explains that on .NET 9+ the handler auto-uses PAR when advertised, so the PushedAuthorizationRequestEndpoint must also be rewritten to the mTLS alias
assertions.rationale: No mention of .NET 9 PAR or rewriting the PAR endpoint.
